purpose: Swappable-slot contracts for electronics (drives, servos, sensors, buses, compute, power). A slot names an interface; any component implementing that interface can be checked against the slot's requirements.

consequences.drop_in: Same interface, connection, mount and simulation-facing parameters. Existing qualification may still need review.
consequences.retune: Connection and mount unchanged, but simulation-facing parameters differ: regenerate the model and requalify (release level reverts to synthetic_only).
consequences.rewire: Function fits, but bus, protocol, connector or command interface differs: wiring, adapter, firmware or driver change required, then retune.
consequences.remount: Mechanical interface differs: the mechanical layer must change, then rewire/retune as applicable.
consequences.incompatible: A hard electrical or performance requirement is not met.

rules.requirement_within_range: Slot requirement (scalar) must lie inside the component's published [min, max].
rules.component_at_least: Component value must be >= the slot requirement.
rules.component_at_most: Component value must be <= the slot requirement.
rules.equals: Component value must equal the slot requirement.
rules.contains: Component list must contain the slot requirement (or every item of a required list).
rules.sim_compare: Not a requirement: compared with the currently bound component; any difference beyond rel_tol means retune.
rules.budget: Not compared per slot: the component's worst-case current on its supply rail, summed by the rail budget check against the rail source's rating.

actuator.smart_servo.description: Integrated motor, gearbox, driver and position sensor on a serial bus.

solver_mapping.stall_torque_Nm, no_load_speed_rpm: Linear torque-speed line: MuJoCo general actuator with forcerange = +/-stall torque and affine bias slope = -stall_torque / no_load_speed (rad/s). Published stall and no-load points are different operating points; the line between them is an assumption.
solver_mapping.gear_ratio: Reflected rotor inertia (armature) = N^2 * J_rotor when J_rotor is known; otherwise unknown, not zero.
solver_mapping.mass_kg: Link mass contribution of the servo body.
solver_mapping.protocol, baud: Bus round-trip latency per control step; sets the feasible control rate for a daisy chain.

drive.stepper.description: Bipolar stepper driver (IC or module) commanded by step/dir or serial.

solver_mapping.phase_current_rms_A: Caps motor torque via the motor's torque-current curve; the driver does not define torque alone.
solver_mapping.microsteps_max: Commanded position quantization = full step / microsteps.
solver_mapping.command_interfaces: Step/dir: command is position increments; open-loop step loss must be modeled or excluded.
solver_mapping.supply_current_max_A: Driver supply current depends on the motor's mechanical power and losses, not the phase-current rating; for budgets declare a proposed per-slot current until the motor is modeled.

drive.bldc_foc.description: Field-oriented brushless motor controller with current/torque, velocity and position modes.

solver_mapping.phase_current_peak_A: Torque limit = Kt * current limit for the bound motor; Kt belongs to the motor, not the controller.
solver_mapping.control_rate_hz: Inner-loop update period; must be faster than the policy action period declared in the episode clock.
solver_mapping.command_bus: Bus latency between policy action and applied setpoint.
solver_mapping.supply_current_max_A: Driver supply current depends on the motor's mechanical power and losses, not the phase-current rating; for budgets declare a proposed per-slot current until the motor is modeled.

solver_mapping.current_continuous_A: Caps sustained motor torque via the motor's torque constant; transient limits need the peak rating and thermal model.
solver_mapping.supply_current_max_A: Driver supply current depends on the motor's mechanical power and losses, not the phase-current rating; for budgets declare a proposed per-slot current until the motor is modeled.

solver_mapping.resolution_bits: Quantization step = 2*pi / 2^bits; accuracy/INL is a separate (usually larger) error term.
solver_mapping.interface: Read latency and sample period on the sensor clock.

solver_mapping.ppr: Quadrature counts = 4 * ppr per encoder-shaft revolution; joint resolution also divides by gear ratio when motor-side.

solver_mapping.noise_density: White-noise std per sample = density * sqrt(bandwidth); bias instability and temperature drift need separate terms.
solver_mapping.odr: Sensor clock rate; capture/release times recorded per sample in the episode contract.
solver_mapping.range: Saturation limits of the simulated measurement.

solver_mapping.adc_resolution_bits: Current-measurement quantization; with a motor torque constant this approximates measured actuator effort.

solver_mapping.output_data_rate_hz: Force-sensor clock; solver contact forces must be filtered/aggregated to this bandwidth before use as a sensor.

solver_mapping.baud_max_bps: Upper bound on bus throughput and hence latency/control rate.

bus.protocol.description: Bus or protocol specification (not a part).

solver_mapping.*: Packet size and bitrate determine per-command latency; record it in the clock contract.

solver_mapping.clock_max_MHz: Bounds feasible control-loop rate and jitter; measure jitter rather than infer it.

solver_mapping.output_current_A: Shared supply limit across actuators; simultaneous stall currents can exceed it (brownout is not modeled by default).

solver_mapping.*: A stop category defines how actuation is removed (torque off vs controlled stop); simulate as an episode termination mode, not a reward.

power.source.description: Battery or bench/wall supply feeding a rail.

solver_mapping.capacity_Wh: Usable energy bound for episodes per charge, once per-episode energy is recorded; rated capacity is not usable capacity at high discharge or low temperature.

rail_budget.method: Worst case: every load on a rail draws its published worst-case current at once (actuators at stall). Sum compared with the rail source's continuous rating; peak rating reported when published.
rail_budget.unknowns: A load with no published worst-case current makes the rail undetermined unless the binding declares a proposed current for that slot; declared values are reported as assumptions, never as published.
rail_budget.not_covered: Dynamic current, inrush, regeneration, voltage sag, conversion efficiency, battery capacity versus discharge rate and temperature. Those need per-episode power traces (engine) and measured current (calibration).
